segment_performance.highlight: Post-merger mortgage disbursements reached record monthly run-rates; retail credit quality remains pristine.
Commercial and institutional loan book grew +17.2% YoY with zero fresh large corporate defaults.
G-Sec yield stability provided mark-to-market trading cushions and liquidity buffer optimization.
PayZapp and SmartGateway merchant transactions crossed 1.2 billion volume during the quarter.

simple_pointers: **Sustained Profit Leadership:** Consolidated Net Profit (PAT) jumped **+35.32% YoY** to **₹16,820 Cr**, reflecting complete post-merger integration synergies.
**Core Net Interest Income Expansion:** Net Interest Income (NII) expanded to **₹29,840 Cr**, maintaining a healthy Net Interest Margin (NIM) of **3.47%**.
**Best-in-Class Asset Quality:** Gross NPA was kept low at **1.33%** and Net NPA at **0.39%**, significantly outperforming banking sector benchmarks.
**Strong Deposit Mobilization:** Total deposits advanced to ₹23.8 Lakh Cr (+16.5% YoY), driven by aggressive branch network expansion in Tier-2/3 cities.
**Exceptional Capital Adequacy:** Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) stood at **19.3%** (Tier-1: 17.1%), offering a massive buffer against credit shocks.

strengths: Unrivaled brand reputation and India's largest private banking branch network (8,800+ branches).
Pristine asset quality with Net NPA under 0.40% and Provision Coverage Ratio (PCR) at ~74%.
High Tier-1 Capital Adequacy (17.1%) providing balance sheet headroom for accelerated retail loan growth.
weaknesses: Credit-to-Deposit (CD) ratio remains higher than pre-merger levels, requiring elevated deposit acquisition costs.
Net Interest Margin (3.47%) remains compressed compared to historical 4.0%+ averages.
opportunities: Cross-selling home loans to existing 85M+ liability customer accounts.
Expanding high-yield co-branded credit cards and rural agriculture lending via digital apps.
threats: Intensified deposit competition from PSU banks and neo-banking wealth apps pushing up cost of funds.
Macroeconomic consumer credit slowdown or unsecured personal loan regulatory tightening by RBI.
